title: Chapter 710
paragraphs: Chapter 710
Episode 179. Unavoidable Trap (9)
Volgar and Bradamante collided in midair, leaving a black crescent in the void. Black energy burst up like lava from the ground split by the shockwave emanating from their clash.
Jin looked up at Diphus, his teeth gritted.
The sharply pointed horns, the black eyes that could never belong to a human, the smile that seemed to enjoy this horrific situation.
He could find no trace of his second eldest brother as he knew him.
Even when they met in the Empire, it was the same, but now it was even more painful.
Because today, he had to finish Diphus once and for all.
"Fourth Flagbearer... lighter than I feared."
Jin's gaze fell on Diphus's left wing and chest.
Although covered by clothes, he could feel the fire still within.
[The result of my carelessness when I faced you in the Empire. That's why I prepared...]
Behind Diphus, fruits containing prisoners were falling continuously from the other side.
Each fruit trapped at least fifty people. Every time a fruit hit the ground, it meant that at least dozens of people were killed or injured.
[Let's enjoy this slowly, little brother.]
There might be Diphus left in that monster.
However, Jin decided to dismiss that thought. If he faced him with a half-hearted mind as Mary had said, the situation would only become more tragic.
'Even if he's wounded by eternalization, the Fourth Order is still a transcendent being. I must fight calmly, even for my brother's sake.'
A tinge of murderous intent entered Jin's eyes.
"Let's see if you can afford to be so leisurely when the fight is over, Fourth Flagbearer. No... the monster that swallowed my brother."
[All the while you were barely concealing your pain, I didn't know you could speak so fiercely.]
Ciiiing-!
The two swords that were intertwined and stationary began to move again.
Jin pushed Diphus away and launched into a light-speed thrust, while Diphus flew backward, swinging Volgar.
In an instant, a massive black sword energy was pounding the ground, obliterating the sight.
Jin parried Diphus's sword energy and charged forward to prevent him from gaining more distance.
There was no time to spare to rescue his companions trapped in the dimension.
Even if they weren't using the Holy Sword, Hedos and the like could open the dimension, so they should be able to escape with time.
'When my comrades escape from the dimension, I have to bind Diphus completely so that I can focus on rescuing the prisoners.'
First, he had to deal with Diphus's mobility.
Only by cutting off the wings could he inflict fatal wounds through eternalization.
Since eternalization couldn't be used in the form of sword energy, he had to somehow lead the fight into close combat.
"You keep running away. Despite sharing the power of the monster, do you not have the confidence to face me head-on?"
[I told you, let's enjoy this slowly. Don't worry, one side is definitely going to end today.]
While pursuing Diphus, Jin continually saw prisoners.
Some fruits were already full of corpses, and in others, the survivors were screaming madly for help.
If Diphus started threatening by taking them hostage, Jin had no way to stop him.

'The Fourth Flagbearer can't just take hostages at will. He must be aware that the moment he starts killing the prisoners, there are no constraints on me and the alliance. If he planned to consume the prisoners in that way, he would have done so from the beginning.'
Then why is Diphus leaving the prisoners like this?
He's not hiding them anywhere, nor is he maintaining a state that would be easy to use as hostages in an emergency.
Rather, the fruits containing the prisoners were scattered around Recalton Castle, as if they were saying "pick them up one by one".
Upon reaching that thought, Jin had a feeling that Diphus was not neglecting the prisoners, but 'positioning' them.
'What's the positioning for?'
Swish-!
Diphus's sword energy grazed Jin's cheek. His sword also had the power to spread chaos like Rosa, so the radiant heart trembled as it repelled the energy.
At the same time, Diphus exploded a fruit nearby, catching Jin's eye.
The people trapped inside were scattered somewhere, shattered along with the fragments of the fruit.
[You shouldn't be paying attention elsewhere when I'm in front of you. If you want all the prisoners to explode and die like that, you can keep doing so......]
Diphus could not finish his sentence.
Because Jin suddenly charged and cut off his left wing.
Diphus couldn't dodge Jin's sword which suddenly became faster than the speed he had perceived while being pursued.
[Tsk!]
If they had been in close combat on the ground, Diphus wouldn't have fallen for this ambush. His sword would have reacted before his head.
However, no matter how fast you are, flight has many constraints, and it wasn't long ago that Diphus acquired the ability to fly.
Jin had been carefully controlling his speed to lead to such small mistakes, as if he was barely catching up.
Of course, it wasn't a situation where he could close the distance instantly if he wanted to. He just used the move he had saved up.
"Stop wasting your time. You want to threaten me with hostages? Go ahead, let's see who dies first. Do you think we came to Recalton without such resolve?"
The actual agreement among the allies on the final operation was to eliminate Diphus, even if in the worst-case scenario all the hostages die.
[Huh, that's right. You're good at lying and deceiving. But to reveal your hidden move just because of a group of hostages...]
Diphus's left wing began to regenerate.
It wasn't as if he hadn't taken any damage. The moment before the blade made contact, there was a brief eternalization on the Bradamante.
But unlike when it was cut in the empire, the energy of eternalization didn't penetrate deep. Because he had hastily unfolded it and cut it more shallowly than before.

[Just now, your choice revealed that you need at least a minimal amount of time to fully use that flame. I will respond more cautiously. So, keep your mind clear, little one. If you want to win. You can't bring me and your mother down with such a human heart.]
"That's something we'll see. But all the guys who talked to me like that are in the underworld, Fourth Flagbearer. Do you think you and the monster will face a different outcome?"
Diphus was creating distance again.
His flight was noticeably slower than before, due to the eternalization sticking to his left wing.
But as a result, the constraints increased and the chase was still not easy.
For some reason, as the chase progressed, the two of them were gradually moving away from Recalton Castle.
Upon reaching the black forest surrounded by spirit energy, Jin realized that there were not many fruits imprisoning the prisoners nearby.
'Now is the time to rescue the prisoners. The comrades should have escaped from the dimension by now, but what about the alliance's fleet?'
At that moment, he felt a massive energy from Recalton Castle.
It was Hedo. He and his comrades had finally pierced the dimension and escaped to Recalton Castle. As soon as Jin confirmed his energy, he set off an orange flare.
The flare meant that he was safe, and they should rescue the prisoners first.
Diphus immediately understood the meaning of the flare.
The orange glow briefly colored the sky, but there was no sense of anyone else approaching this way.
[It seems you took my advice lightly. Wouldn't it be better to give up on the prisoners and attack me with your comrades?]
“That’s not for you to judge.”
The main reason Diphus had been luring Jin away from Licarton Castle was because of Hedo and his allies.
In his current state, he didn’t think he could withstand a combined attack from Jin and his comrades alone.

Jin was vaguely aware of Diphus's intention, but getting further away from Licarton wasn't entirely a bad choice for him either. This was because he could avoid situations where Diphus threatened the lives of the prisoners.
Above all, Jin was confident that he wouldn’t lose even if he ended up fighting Diphus one-on-one, even if Diphus was hiding a lot of power.
[I knew you'd answer that way. You would have come this far knowing it was a trap in the first place. Anyway, this should be enough.]
Suddenly, Diphus stopped flying. The towering black trees were hiding Jin and Diphus.
[One last thing I want to ask, little brother. Between your comrades you brought and the prisoners... which group do you hope will safely return to Teiken alive?]

-[You're really making me frustrated. This is why you and Joshua always get beaten by the youngest. Now is a greater crisis than ever. Mother can't move, and the fire on me might not go out until the little one arrives. That means if a battle breaks out, I might be pushed by the little one.]
-[You, could lose?]
-[Yes, that's why we need to devise a plan. A plan where even if I lose, Runcandel won't.]
The conversation between Ilina and Diphus before the operation started.
The plan Diphus had made then, was just now completed.
Whaaa!
The black trees disintegrated into particles and the surroundings were instantly shrouded in black mist. Even causing a wind blade couldn’t disperse the mist.
‘It doesn’t seem like an aether space. What is it?’
Jin couldn’t confirm Diphus's figure with his eyes, but he aimed his sword towards where he could sense his aura.
After a while, the mist seemed to suddenly clear.
Upon checking his surroundings, Jin realized that he wasn't standing in the center of Licarton.
Looking back, neither Licarton Castle nor the trees holding the prisoners were visible.
‘... Teleportation? No way, was that mist a dimensional gate?’
That was correct.
Diphus had just used the power of Hyungshin in a hurry to open a dimensional gate and teleport.
He was standing on the ground, not in the air. The left wing that was cut off by Jin and regenerated could be seen falling to the ground.
[It seems difficult to answer. But whichever side you want to save more, you can't go to save them now. This place is quite far from Licarton Castle…….]
Diphus said so, lifting his greatsword, Bolvar.
